name: Radial Dissolve Brand Card
description: A Swiss-editorial brand identity bento card featuring a real-time 60fps radial dissolve shader that morphs an 8-spoke emblem across smooth, scanline halftone, and ASCII matrix states, paired with isometric mobile app icon and browser favicon mockups.
